verses.english: [Related Aramaic proclamation occurs at 3:31–33; not repeated here.]
King Belshazzar held a great feast for a thousand of his nobles and drank wine before the thousand.
verses.hebrew: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר מַלְכָּא עֲבַד לְחֶם רַב לְרַבְרְבָנוֹהִי אֲלַף וְלָקֳבֵל אַלְפָּא חַמְרָא שָׁתֵה׃

verses.english: Belshazzar, under the influence of the wine, ordered the gold and silver vessels that his father Nebuchadnezzar had taken from the temple in Jerusalem to be brought, so that the king, his nobles, his wives, and his concubines could drink from them.
verses.hebrew: בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר אֲמַר בִּטְעֵם חַמְרָא לְהַיְתָיָה לְמָאנֵי דַּהֲבָא וְכַסְפָּא דִּי הַנְפֵּק נְבוּכַדְנֶצַּר אֲבוּהִי מִן־הֵיכְלָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וְיִשְׁתּוֹן בְּהוֹן מַלְכָּא וְרַבְרְבָנוֹהִי שֵׁגְלָתֵהּ וּלְחֵנָתֵהּ׃

verses.english: Then they brought the gold vessels taken from the temple of God’s house in Jerusalem, and the king, his nobles, his wives, and his concubines drank from them.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן הַיְתִיו מָאנֵי דַהֲבָא דִּי הַנְפִּקוּ מִן־הֵיכְלָא דִּי־בֵית אֱלָהָא דִּי בִירוּשְׁלֶם וְאִשְׁתִּיו בְּהוֹן מַלְכָּא וְרַבְרְבָנוֹהִי שֵׁגְלָתֵהּ וּלְחֵנָתֵהּ׃

verses.english: They drank wine and praised the gods of gold and silver, bronze, iron, wood, and stone.
verses.hebrew: אִשְׁתִּיו חַמְרָא וְשַׁבַּחוּ לֵאלָהֵי דַּהֲבָא וְכַסְפָּא נְחָשָׁא פַרְזְלָא אָעָא וְאַבְנָא׃

verses.english: At that very hour the fingers of a human hand came out and wrote opposite the lampstand on the plaster of the wall of the king’s palace. The king saw the part of the hand that was writing.
verses.hebrew: בַּהּ־שַׁעֲתָה נפקו [נְפַקָה] אֶצְבְּעָן דִּי יַד־אֱנָשׁ וְכָתְבָן לָקֳבֵל נֶבְרַשְׁתָּא עַל־גִּירָא דִּי־כְתַל הֵיכְלָא דִּי מַלְכָּא וּמַלְכָּא חָזֵה פַּס יְדָה דִּי כָתְבָה׃

verses.english: Then the king’s color changed, and his thoughts alarmed him. The joints of his hips loosened, and his knees knocked together.
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן מַלְכָּא זִיוֺהִי שְׁנוֹהִי וְרַעיֹנֹהִי יְבַהֲלוּנֵּהּ וְקִטְרֵי חַרְצֵהּ מִשְׁתָּרַיִן וְאַרְכֻבָּתֵהּ דָּא לְדָא נָקְשָׁן׃

verses.english: The king called loudly for the enchanters, Chaldeans, and diviners to be brought in. He answered and said to Babylon’s wise men, “Whoever reads this writing and tells me its interpretation will be clothed in purple, wear a gold chain around his neck, and rule as third in the kingdom.”
verses.hebrew: קָרֵא מַלְכָּא בְּחַיִל לְהֶעָלָה לְאָשְׁפַיָּא כשדיא [כַּשְׂדָּאֵי] וְגָזְרַיָּא עָנֵה מַלְכָּא וְאָמַר לְחַכִּימֵי בָבֶל דִּי כָל־אֱנָשׁ דִּי־יִקְרֵה כְּתָבָה דְנָה וּפִשְׁרֵהּ יְחַוִּנַּנִי אַרְגְּוָנָא יִלְבַּשׁ והמונכא [וְהַמְנִיכָא] דִי־דַהֲבָא עַל־צַוְּארֵהּ וְתַלְתִּי בְמַלְכוּתָא יִשְׁלַט׃

verses.english: Then all the king’s wise men came in, but they could not read the writing or make its interpretation known to the king.
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן עללין [עָלִּין] כֹּל חַכִּימֵי מַלְכָּא וְלָא־כָהֲלִין כְּתָבָא לְמִקְרֵא ופשרא [וּפִשְׁרֵהּ] לְהוֹדָעָה לְמַלְכָּא׃

verses.english: Then King Belshazzar was greatly alarmed, his color changed, and his nobles were bewildered.
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן מַלְכָּא בֵלְשַׁאצַּר שַׂגִּיא מִתְבָּהַל וְזִיוֺהִי שָׁנַיִן עֲלוֹהִי וְרַבְרְבָנוֹהִי מִשְׁתַּבְּשִׁין׃

verses.english: The queen entered the banquet hall because of the words of the king and his nobles. The queen answered and said, “O king, live forever! Do not let your thoughts alarm you, and do not let your color change.
verses.hebrew: מַלְכְּתָא לָקֳבֵל מִלֵּי מַלְכָּא וְרַבְרְבָנוֹהִי לְבֵית מִשְׁתְּיָא עללת [עַלַּת] עֲנָת מַלְכְּתָא וַאֲמֶרֶת מַלְכָּא לְעָלְמִין חֱיִי אַל־יְבַהֲלוּךְ רַעְיוֹנָךְ וְזִיוָיךְ אַל־יִשְׁתַּנּוֹ׃

verses.english: There is a man in your kingdom in whom is a spirit of holy gods. In your father’s days, illumination, understanding, and wisdom like the gods’ wisdom were found in him. King Nebuchadnezzar, your father—your father the king—appointed him chief of magicians, enchanters, Chaldeans, and diviners,
verses.hebrew: אִיתַי גְּבַר בְּמַלְכוּתָךְ דִּי רוּחַ אֱלָהִין קַדִּישִׁין בֵּהּ וּבְיוֹמֵי אֲבוּךְ נַהִירוּ וְשָׂכְלְתָנוּ וְחָכְמָה כְּחָכְמַת־אֱלָהִין הִשְׁתְּכַחַת בֵּהּ וּמַלְכָּא נְבֻכַדְנֶצַּר אֲבוּךְ רַב חַרְטֻמִּין אָשְׁפִין כַּשְׂדָּאִין גָּזְרִין הֲקִימֵהּ אֲבוּךְ מַלְכָּא׃

verses.english: because an exceptional spirit, knowledge, understanding, interpretation of dreams, explanation of riddles, and untying of knots were found in this Daniel, whom the king named Belteshazzar. Now let Daniel be called, and he will give the interpretation.”
verses.hebrew: כָּל־קֳבֵל דִּי רוּחַ יַתִּירָה וּמַנְדַּע וְשָׂכְלְתָנוּ מְפַשַּׁר חֶלְמִין וַאַחֲוָיַת אֲחִידָן וּמְשָׁרֵא קִטְרִין הִשְׁתְּכַחַת בֵּהּ בְּדָנִיֵּאל דִּי־מַלְכָּא שָׂם־שְׁמֵהּ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר כְּעַן דָּנִיֵּאל יִתְקְרֵי וּפִשְׁרָה יְהַחֲוֵה׃

verses.english: Then Daniel was brought before the king. The king answered and said to Daniel, “Are you Daniel, one of the exiles of Judah whom my father the king brought from Judah?
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן דָּנִיֵּאל הֻעַל קֳדָם מַלְכָּא עָנֵה מַלְכָּא וְאָמַר לְדָנִיֵּאל אנתה־[אַנְתְּ־] הוּא דָנִיֵּאל דִּי־מִן־בְּנֵי גָלוּתָא דִּי יְהוּד דִּי הַיְתִי מַלְכָּא אַבִי מִן־יְהוּד׃

verses.english: But I have heard that you can give interpretations and untie knots. Now, if you can read the writing and make its interpretation known to me, you will be clothed in purple, wear a gold chain around your neck, and rule as third in the kingdom.”
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנָה שִׁמְעֵת עליך [עֲלָךְ] דִּי־תוכל [תִיכּוּל] פִּשְׁרִין לְמִפְשַׁר וְקִטְרִין לְמִשְׁרֵא כְּעַן הֵן תוכל [תִּכוּל] כְּתָבָא לְמִקְרֵא וּפִשְׁרֵהּ לְהוֹדָעֻתַנִי אַרְגְּוָנָא תִלְבַּשׁ והמונכא [וְהַמְנִיכָא] דִי־דַהֲבָא עַל־צַוְּארָךְ וְתַלְתָּא בְמַלְכוּתָא תִּשְׁלַט׃

verses.english: Then Daniel answered before the king, “Let your gifts remain yours, and give your rewards to someone else. Nevertheless, I will read the writing to the king and make the interpretation known to him.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן עָנֵה דָנִיֵּאל וְאָמַר קֳדָם מַלְכָּא מַתְּנָתָךְ לָךְ לֶהֶוְיָן וּנְבָזְבְּיָתָךְ לְאָחֳרָן הַב בְּרַם כְּתָבָא אֶקְרֵא לְמַלְכָּא וּפִשְׁרָא אֲהוֹדְעִנֵּהּ׃

verses.english: You have exalted yourself against the Lord of heaven. The vessels of His house were brought before you, and you, your nobles, your wives, and your concubines drank wine from them. You praised the gods of silver and gold, bronze, iron, wood, and stone, which neither see nor hear nor know. But the God in whose hand is your breath and to whom belong all your ways, you have not honored.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל מָרֵא־שְׁמַיָּא הִתְרוֹמַמְתָּ וּלְמָאנַיָּא דִי־בַיְתֵהּ הַיְתִיו קדמיך [קָדָמָךְ] ואנתה [וְאַנְתְּ] ורברבניך [וְרַבְרְבָנָךְ] שֵׁגְלָתָךְ וּלְחֵנָתָךְ חַמְרָא שָׁתַיִן בְּהוֹן וְלֵאלָהֵי כַסְפָּא־וְדַהֲבָא נְחָשָׁא פַרְזְלָא אָעָא וְאַבְנָא דִּי לָא־חָזַיִן וְלָא־שָׁמְעִין וְלָא יָדְעִין שַׁבַּחְתָּ וְלֵאלָהָא דִּי־נִשְׁמְתָךְ בִּידֵהּ וְכָל־אֹרְחָתָךְ לֵהּ לָא הַדַּרְתָּ׃

verses.english: This is the interpretation of the matter: Mene—God has numbered your kingship and brought it to an end. Tekel—you have been weighed in the balances and found deficient. Peres—your kingdom has been divided and given to Media and Persia.
verses.hebrew: דְּנָה פְּשַׁר־מִלְּתָא מְנֵא מְנָה־אֱלָהָא מַלְכוּתָךְ וְהַשְׁלְמַהּ׃ תְּקֵל תְּקִילְתָּה בְמֹאזַנְיָא וְהִשְׁתְּכַחַתְּ חַסִּיר׃ פְּרֵס פְּרִיסַת מַלְכוּתָךְ וִיהִיבַת לְמָדַי וּפָרָס׃

verses.english: This is the interpretation of the matter: Mene—God has numbered your kingship and brought it to an end. Tekel—you have been weighed in the balances and found deficient. Peres—your kingdom has been divided and given to Media and Persia.
verses.hebrew: דְּנָה פְּשַׁר־מִלְּתָא מְנֵא מְנָה־אֱלָהָא מַלְכוּתָךְ וְהַשְׁלְמַהּ׃ תְּקֵל תְּקִילְתָּה בְמֹאזַנְיָא וְהִשְׁתְּכַחַתְּ חַסִּיר׃ פְּרֵס פְּרִיסַת מַלְכוּתָךְ וִיהִיבַת לְמָדַי וּפָרָס׃

verses.english: This is the interpretation of the matter: Mene—God has numbered your kingship and brought it to an end. Tekel—you have been weighed in the balances and found deficient. Peres—your kingdom has been divided and given to Media and Persia.
verses.hebrew: דְּנָה פְּשַׁר־מִלְּתָא מְנֵא מְנָה־אֱלָהָא מַלְכוּתָךְ וְהַשְׁלְמַהּ׃ תְּקֵל תְּקִילְתָּה בְמֹאזַנְיָא וְהִשְׁתְּכַחַתְּ חַסִּיר׃ פְּרֵס פְּרִיסַת מַלְכוּתָךְ וִיהִיבַת לְמָדַי וּפָרָס׃

verses.english: Then Belshazzar gave the order, and they clothed Daniel in purple, placed a gold chain around his neck, and proclaimed concerning him that he should rule as third in the kingdom.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן אֲמַר בֵּלְשַׁאצַּר וְהַלְבִּישׁוּ לְדָנִיֵּאל אַרְגְּוָנָא והמונכא [וְהַמְנִיכָא] דִי־דַהֲבָא עַל־צַוְּארֵהּ וְהַכְרִזוּ עֲלוֹהִי דִּי־לֶהֱוֵא שַׁלִּיט תַּלְתָּא בְּמַלְכוּתָא׃

verses.english: That very night Belshazzar, king of the Chaldeans, was killed.
verses.hebrew: בֵּהּ בְּלֵילְיָא קְטִיל בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר מַלְכָּא כשדיא [כַשְׂדָּאָה׃]

verses.english: Darius the Mede received the kingdom when he was about sixty-two years old.
verses.hebrew: וְדָרְיָוֶשׁ מָדָיָא קַבֵּל מַלְכוּתָא כְּבַר שְׁנִין שִׁתִּין וְתַרְתֵּין׃

verses.english: Darius was pleased to appoint one hundred twenty satraps over the kingdom, to be throughout the whole kingdom,
verses.hebrew: שְׁפַר קֳדָם דָּרְיָוֶשׁ וַהֲקִים עַל־מַלְכוּתָא לַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא מְאָה וְעֶשְׂרִין דִּי לֶהֱוֺן בְּכָל־מַלְכוּתָא׃

verses.english: and over them three administrators, of whom Daniel was one, so that these satraps would give them an account and the king suffer no loss.
verses.hebrew: וְעֵלָּא מִנְּהוֹן סָרְכִין תְּלָתָא דִּי דָנִיֵּאל חַד־מִנְּהוֹן דִּי־לֶהֱוֺן אֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא אִלֵּין יָהֲבִין לְהוֹן טַעְמָא וּמַלְכָּא לָא־לֶהֱוֵא נָזִק׃

verses.english: This Daniel distinguished himself above the administrators and satraps because an exceptional spirit was in him, and the king intended to appoint him over the whole kingdom.
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן דָּנִיֵּאל דְּנָה הֲוָא מִתְנַצַּח עַל־סָרְכַיָּא וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא כָּל־קֳבֵל דִּי רוּחַ יַתִּירָא בֵּהּ וּמַלְכָּא עֲשִׁית לַהֲקָמוּתֵהּ עַל־כָּל־מַלְכוּתָא׃

verses.english: Then the administrators and satraps sought grounds for an accusation against Daniel concerning the kingdom. But they could find no ground or corruption, because he was trustworthy, and no negligence or corruption was found in him.
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן סָרְכַיָּא וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא הֲווֹ בָעַיִן עִלָּה לְהַשְׁכָּחָה לְדָנִיֵּאל מִצַּד מַלְכוּתָא וְכָל־עִלָּה וּשְׁחִיתָה לָא־יָכְלִין לְהַשְׁכָּחָה כָּל־קֳבֵל דִּי־מְהֵימַן הוּא וְכָל־שָׁלוּ וּשְׁחִיתָה לָא הִשְׁתְּכַחַת עֲלוֹהִי׃

verses.english: Then these men said, “We will find no ground against this Daniel unless we find it concerning the law of his God.”
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ אָמְרִין דִּי לָא נְהַשְׁכַּח לְדָנִיֵּאל דְּנָה כָּל־עִלָּא לָהֵן הַשְׁכַּחְנָה עֲלוֹהִי בְּדָת אֱלָהֵהּ׃

verses.english: Then these administrators and satraps came together to the king and said to him, “King Darius, live forever!
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן סָרְכַיָּא וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא אִלֵּן הַרְגִּשׁוּ עַל־מַלְכָּא וְכֵן אָמְרִין לֵהּ דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא לְעָלְמִין חֱיִי׃

verses.english: All the kingdom’s administrators, prefects, satraps, advisers, and governors have agreed that the king should establish a statute and enforce a restriction: whoever makes a petition to any god or human being for thirty days, except to you, O king, must be thrown into the lions’ pit.
verses.hebrew: אִתְיָעַטוּ כֹּל סָרְכֵי מַלְכוּתָא סִגְנַיָּא וַאֲחַשְׁדַּרְפְּנַיָּא הַדָּבְרַיָּא וּפַחֲוָתָא לְקַיָּמָה קְיָם מַלְכָּא וּלְתַקָּפָה אֱסָר דִּי כָל־דִּי־יִבְעֵה בָעוּ מִן־כָּל־אֱלָהּ וֶאֱנָשׁ עַד־יוֹמִין תְּלָתִין לָהֵן מִנָּךְ מַלְכָּא יִתְרְמֵא לְגֹב אַרְיָוָתָא׃

verses.english: Now, O king, establish the restriction and inscribe the document, so that it cannot be changed, according to the law of Media and Persia, which cannot be revoked.”
verses.hebrew: כְּעַן מַלְכָּא תְּקִים אֱסָרָא וְתִרְשֻׁם כְּתָבָא דִּי לָא לְהַשְׁנָיָה כְּדָת־מָדַי וּפָרַס דִּי־לָא תֶעְדֵּא׃

verses.english: Therefore King Darius inscribed the document and restriction.
verses.hebrew: כָּל־קֳבֵל דְּנָה מַלְכָּא דָּרְיָוֶשׁ רְשַׁם כְּתָבָא וֶאֱסָרָא׃

verses.english: When Daniel learned that the document had been inscribed, he went into his house. The windows in his upper room were open toward Jerusalem. Three times a day he knelt, prayed, and gave thanks before his God, just as he had done before.
verses.hebrew: וְדָנִיֵּאל כְּדִי יְדַע דִּי־רְשִׁים כְּתָבָא עַל לְבַיְתֵהּ וְכַוִּין פְּתִיחָן לֵהּ בְּעִלִּיתֵהּ נֶגֶד יְרוּשְׁלֶם וְזִמְנִין תְּלָתָה בְיוֹמָא הוּא בָּרֵךְ עַל־בִּרְכוֹהִי וּמְצַלֵּא וּמוֹדֵא קֳדָם אֱלָהֵהּ כָּל־קֳבֵל דִּי־הֲוָא עָבֵד מִן־קַדְמַת דְּנָה׃

verses.english: Then these men came together and found Daniel making petition and seeking mercy before his God.
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ הַרְגִּשׁוּ וְהַשְׁכַּחוּ לְדָנִיֵּאל בָּעֵא וּמִתְחַנַּן קֳדָם אֱלָהֵהּ׃

verses.english: Then they approached and spoke before the king about the royal restriction: “Did you not inscribe a restriction that anyone who petitions any god or human being for thirty days, except you, O king, must be thrown into the lions’ pit?” The king answered and said, “The matter stands, according to the law of Media and Persia, which cannot be revoked.”
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן קְרִיבוּ וְאָמְרִין קֳדָם־מַלְכָּא עַל־אֱסָר מַלְכָּא הֲלָא אֱסָר רְשַׁמְתָּ דִּי כָל־אֱנָשׁ דִּי־יִבְעֵה מִן־כָּל־אֱלָהּ וֶאֱנָשׁ עַד־יוֹמִין תְּלָתִין לָהֵן מִנָּךְ מַלְכָּא יִתְרְמֵא לְגוֹב אַרְיָותָא עָנֵה מַלְכָּא וְאָמַר יַצִּיבָא מִלְּתָא כְּדָת־מָדַי וּפָרַס דִּי־לָא תֶעְדֵּא׃

verses.english: [No separate Aramaic counterpart at this position.]
Then they answered and said before the king, “Daniel, one of the exiles of Judah, pays no regard to you, O king, or to the restriction you inscribed. He makes his petition three times a day.”
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן עֲנוֹ וְאָמְרִין קֳדָם מַלְכָּא דִּי דָנִיֵּאל דִּי מִן־בְּנֵי גָלוּתָא דִּי יְהוּד לָא־שָׂם עליך [עֲלָךְ] מַלְכָּא טְעֵם וְעַל־אֱסָרָא דִּי רְשַׁמְתָּ וְזִמְנִין תְּלָתָה בְּיוֹמָא בָּעֵא בָּעוּתֵהּ׃

verses.english: When the king heard the matter, he was greatly distressed. He set his mind on rescuing Daniel and worked until sunset to deliver him.
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן מַלְכָּא כְּדִי מִלְּתָא שְׁמַע שַׂגִּיא בְּאֵשׁ עֲלוֹהִי וְעַל דָּנִיֵּאל שָׂם בָּל לְשֵׁיזָבוּתֵהּ וְעַד מֶעָלֵי שִׁמְשָׁא הֲוָא מִשְׁתַּדַּר לְהַצָּלוּתֵהּ׃

verses.english: Then these men came together to the king and said to the king, “Know, O king, that it is the law of Media and Persia that no restriction or statute the king establishes can be changed.”
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן גֻּבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ הַרְגִּשׁוּ עַל־מַלְכָּא וְאָמְרִין לְמַלְכָּא דַּע מַלְכָּא דִּי־דָת לְמָדַי וּפָרַס דִּי־כָל־אֱסָר וּקְיָם דִּי־מַלְכָּא יְהָקֵים לָא לְהַשְׁנָיָה׃

verses.english: Then the king gave the order, and they brought Daniel and threw him into the lions’ pit. The king answered and said to Daniel, “Your God, whom you serve continually, He will rescue you.”
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן מַלְכָּא אֲמַר וְהַיְתִיו לְדָנִיֵּאל וּרְמוֹ לְגֻבָּא דִּי אַרְיָוָתָא עָנֵה מַלְכָּא וְאָמַר לְדָנִיֵּאל אֱלָהָךְ דִּי אנתה [אַנְתְּ] פָּלַח־לֵהּ בִּתְדִירָא הוּא יְשֵׁיזְבִנָּךְ׃

verses.english: A stone was brought and placed over the mouth of the pit. The king sealed it with his signet ring and his nobles’ signet rings, so that nothing concerning Daniel could be changed.
verses.hebrew: וְהֵיתָיִת אֶבֶן חֲדָה וְשֻׂמַת עַל־פֻּם גֻּבָּא וְחַתְמַהּ מַלְכָּא בְּעִזְקְתֵהּ וּבְעִזְקָת רַבְרְבָנוֹהִי דִּי לָא־תִשְׁנֵא צְבוּ בְּדָנִיֵּאל׃

verses.english: Then the king went to his palace and spent the night fasting. No diversions were brought before him, and sleep fled from him.
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן אֲזַל מַלְכָּא לְהֵיכְלֵהּ וּבָת טְוָת וְדַחֲוָן לָא־הַנְעֵל קָדָמוֹהִי וְשִׁנְתֵּהּ נַדַּת עֲלוֹהִי׃

verses.english: Then the king rose at the first light of dawn and hurried to the lions’ pit.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן מַלְכָּא בִּשְׁפַּרְפָּרָא יְקוּם בְּנָגְהָא וּבְהִתְבְּהָלָה לְגֻבָּא דִי־אַרְיָוָתָא אֲזַל׃

verses.english: As the king approached the pit, he called to Daniel in a distressed voice, “Daniel, servant of the living God, has your God, whom you serve continually, been able to rescue you from the lions?”
verses.hebrew: וּכְמִקְרְבֵהּ לְגֻבָּא לְדָנִיֵּאל בְּקָל עֲצִיב זְעִק עָנֵה מַלְכָּא וְאָמַר לְדָנִיֵּאל דָּנִיֵּאל עֲבֵד אֱלָהָא חַיָּא אֱלָהָךְ דִּי אנתה [אַנְתְּ] פָּלַח־לֵהּ בִּתְדִירָא הַיְכִל לְשֵׁיזָבוּתָךְ מִן־אַרְיָוָתָא׃

verses.english: Then Daniel spoke to the king, “O king, live forever!
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן דָּנִיֶּאל עִם־מַלְכָּא מַלִּל מַלְכָּא לְעָלְמִין חֱיִי׃

verses.english: My God sent His angel and shut the lions’ mouths, and they have not harmed me, because innocence was found in me before Him. And before you also, O king, I have done no harm.”
verses.hebrew: אֱלָהִי שְׁלַח מַלְאֲכֵהּ וּסֲגַר פֻּם אַרְיָוָתָא וְלָא חַבְּלוּנִי כָּל־קֳבֵל דִּי קָדָמוֹהִי זָכוּ הִשְׁתְּכַחַת לִי וְאַף קדמיך [קָדָמָךְ] מַלְכָּא חֲבוּלָה לָא עַבְדֵת׃

verses.english: Then the king was exceedingly glad and ordered Daniel lifted out of the pit. Daniel was lifted from the pit, and no harm was found in him, because he had trusted in his God.
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן מַלְכָּא שַׂגִּיא טְאֵב עֲלוֹהִי וּלְדָנִיֵּאל אֲמַר לְהַנְסָקָה מִן־גֻּבָּא וְהֻסַּק דָּנִיֵּאל מִן־גֻּבָּא וְכָל־חֲבָל לָא־הִשְׁתְּכַח בֵּהּ דִּי הֵימִן בֵּאלָהֵהּ׃

verses.english: The king gave the order, and they brought those men who had denounced Daniel and threw them into the lions’ pit—they, their children, and their wives. Before they reached the bottom of the pit, the lions overpowered them and crushed all their bones.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲמַר מַלְכָּא וְהַיְתִיו גֻּבְרַיָּא אִלֵּךְ דִּי־אֲכַלוּ קַרְצוֹהִי דִּי דָנִיֵּאל וּלְגֹב אַרְיָוָתָא רְמוֹ אִנּוּן בְּנֵיהוֹן וּנְשֵׁיהוֹן וְלָא־מְטוֹ לְאַרְעִית גֻּבָּא עַד דִּי־שְׁלִטוּ בְהוֹן אַרְיָוָתָא וְכָל־גַּרְמֵיהוֹן הַדִּקוּ׃

verses.english: Then King Darius wrote to all peoples, nations, and languages dwelling in all the earth: “May your peace abound!
verses.hebrew: בֵּאדַיִן דָּרְיָוֶשׁ מַלְכָּא כְּתַב לְכָל־עַמְמַיָּא אֻמַיָּא וְלִשָּׁנַיָּא דִּי־דארין [דָיְרִין] בְּכָל־אַרְעָא שְׁלָמְכוֹן יִשְׂגֵּא׃

verses.english: I issue a decree that throughout my kingdom’s dominion people must tremble and fear before Daniel’s God. For He is the living God, enduring forever; His kingdom will not be destroyed, and His dominion extends to the end.
verses.hebrew: מִן־קֳדָמַי שִׂים טְעֵם דִּי בְּכָל־שָׁלְטָן מַלְכוּתִי לֶהֱוֺן זאעין [זָיְעִין] וְדָחֲלִין מִן־קֳדָם אֱלָהֵהּ דִּי־דָנִיֵּאל דִּי־הוּא אֱלָהָא חַיָּא וְקַיָּם לְעָלְמִין וּמַלְכוּתֵהּ דִּי־לָא תִתְחַבַּל וְשָׁלְטָנֵהּ עַד־סוֹפָא׃

verses.english: He rescues and delivers and performs signs and wonders in heaven and on earth; He has rescued Daniel from the lions’ power.”
verses.hebrew: מְשֵׁיזִב וּמַצִּל וְעָבֵד אָתִין וְתִמְהִין בִּשְׁמַיָּא וּבְאַרְעָא דִּי שֵׁיזִיב לְדָנִיֵּאל מִן־יַד אַרְיָוָתָא׃

verses.english: This Daniel prospered in the reign of Darius and in the reign of Cyrus the Persian.
verses.hebrew: וְדָנִיֵּאל דְּנָה הַצְלַח בְּמַלְכוּת דָּרְיָוֶשׁ וּבְמַלְכוּת כּוֹרֶשׁ פרסיא [פָּרְסָאָה׃]

verses.english: In the first year of Belshazzar, king of Babylon, Daniel saw a dream and visions of his head upon his bed. Then he wrote the dream and related the chief points.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת חֲדָה לְבֵלְאשַׁצַּר מֶלֶךְ בָּבֶל דָּנִיֵּאל חֵלֶם חֲזָה וְחֶזְוֵי רֵאשֵׁהּ עַל־מִשְׁכְּבֵהּ בֵּאדַיִן חֶלְמָא כְתַב רֵאשׁ מִלִּין אֲמַר׃

verses.english: Daniel answered and said, “I was looking in my vision by night, and there were the four winds of heaven stirring up the great sea.
verses.hebrew: עָנֵה דָנִיֵּאל וְאָמַר חָזֵה הֲוֵית בְּחֶזְוִי עִם־לֵילְיָא וַאֲרוּ אַרְבַּע רוּחֵי שְׁמַיָּא מְגִיחָן לְיַמָּא רַבָּא׃

verses.english: Four great beasts came up from the sea, each different from the other.
verses.hebrew: וְאַרְבַּע חֵיוָן רַבְרְבָן סָלְקָן מִן־יַמָּא שָׁנְיָן דָּא מִן־דָּא׃

verses.english: The first was like a lion and had eagle’s wings. I watched until its wings were plucked out, it was lifted from the earth and made to stand on two feet like a human, and a human heart was given it.
verses.hebrew: קַדְמָיְתָא כְאַרְיֵה וְגַפִּין דִּי־נְשַׁר לַהּ חָזֵה הֲוֵית עַד דִּי־מְּרִיטוּ גַפַּיהּ וּנְטִילַת מִן־אַרְעָא וְעַל־רַגְלַיִן כֶּאֱנָשׁ הֳקִימַת וּלְבַב אֱנָשׁ יְהִיב לַהּ׃

verses.english: There was another beast, a second, resembling a bear. It was raised on one side and had three ribs in its mouth between its teeth. They said to it, ‘Rise, eat much flesh!’
verses.hebrew: וַאֲרוּ חֵיוָה אָחֳרִי תִנְיָנָה דָּמְיָה לְדֹב וְלִשְׂטַר־חַד הֳקִמַת וּתְלָת עִלְעִין בְּפֻמַּהּ בֵּין שניה [שִׁנַּהּ] וְכֵן אָמְרִין לַהּ קוּמִי אֲכֻלִי בְּשַׂר שַׂגִּיא׃

verses.english: After this I looked, and there was another, like a leopard, with four bird’s wings upon its back. The beast had four heads, and dominion was given it.
verses.hebrew: בָּאתַר דְּנָה חָזֵה הֲוֵית וַאֲרוּ אָחֳרִי כִּנְמַר וְלַהּ גַּפִּין אַרְבַּע דִּי־עוֹף עַל־גביה [גַּבַּהּ] וְאַרְבְּעָה רֵאשִׁין לְחֵיוְתָא וְשָׁלְטָן יְהִיב לַהּ׃

verses.english: After this I looked in the night visions, and there was a fourth beast, terrifying, dreadful, and exceedingly strong. It had great iron teeth; it devoured and crushed, and trampled what remained with its feet. It differed from all the beasts before it and had ten horns.
verses.hebrew: בָּאתַר דְּנָה חָזֵה הֲוֵית בְּחֶזְוֵי לֵילְיָא וַאֲרוּ חֵיוָה רביעיה [רְבִיעָאָה] דְּחִילָה וְאֵימְתָנִי וְתַקִּיפָא יַתִּירָא וְשִׁנַּיִן דִּי־פַרְזֶל לַהּ רַבְרְבָן אָכְלָה וּמַדֱּקָה וּשְׁאָרָא ברגליה [בְּרַגְלַהּ] רָפְסָה וְהִיא מְשַׁנְּיָה מִן־כָּל־חֵיוָתָא דִּי קָדָמַיהּ וְקַרְנַיִן עֲשַׂר לַהּ׃

verses.english: I was considering the horns, and there was another horn, a small one, rising among them. Three of the former horns were uprooted before it. There were eyes like human eyes in this horn, and a mouth speaking great things.
verses.hebrew: מִשְׂתַּכַּל הֲוֵית בְּקַרְנַיָּא וַאֲלוּ קֶרֶן אָחֳרִי זְעֵירָה סִלְקָת ביניהון [בֵּינֵיהֵן] וּתְלָת מִן־קַרְנַיָּא קַדְמָיָתָא אתעקרו [אֶתְעֲקַרָה] מִן־קדמיה [קֳדָמַהּ] וַאֲלוּ עַיְנִין כְּעַיְנֵי אֲנָשָׁא בְּקַרְנָא־דָא וּפֻם מְמַלִּל רַבְרְבָן׃

verses.english: I watched until thrones were set in place and an Ancient of Days sat down. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of His head like pure wool. His throne was flames of fire; its wheels were blazing fire.
verses.hebrew: חָזֵה הֲוֵית עַד דִּי כָרְסָוָן רְמִיו וְעַתִּיק יוֹמִין יְתִב לְבוּשֵׁהּ כִּתְלַג חִוָּר וּשְׂעַר רֵאשֵׁהּ כַּעֲמַר נְקֵא כָּרְסְיֵהּ שְׁבִיבִין דִּי־נוּר גַּלְגִּלּוֹהִי נוּר דָּלִק׃

verses.english: A river of fire streamed forth and came out from before Him. A thousand thousands served Him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before Him. The court sat, and books were opened.
verses.hebrew: נְהַר דִּי־נוּר נָגֵד וְנָפֵק מִן־קֳדָמוֹהִי אֶלֶף אלפים [אַלְפִין] יְשַׁמְּשׁוּנֵּהּ וְרִבּוֹ רבון [רִבְבָן] קָדָמוֹהִי יְקוּמוּן דִּינָא יְתִב וְסִפְרִין פְּתִיחוּ׃

verses.english: I watched then because of the sound of the great words the horn was speaking. I watched until the beast was killed, its body destroyed, and it was given over to burning fire.
verses.hebrew: חָזֵה הֲוֵית בֵּאדַיִן מִן־קָל מִלַּיָּא רַבְרְבָתָא דִּי קַרְנָא מְמַלֱּלָה חָזֵה הֲוֵית עַד דִּי קְטִילַת חֵיוְתָא וְהוּבַד גִּשְׁמַהּ וִיהִיבַת לִיקֵדַת אֶשָּׁא׃

verses.english: As for the remaining beasts, their dominion was taken away, but an extension of life was given them for a season and a period.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁאָר חֵיוָתָא הֶעְדִּיו שָׁלְטָנְהוֹן וְאַרְכָה בְחַיִּין יְהִיבַת לְהוֹן עַד־זְמַן וְעִדָּן׃

verses.english: I looked in the night visions, and there, with the clouds of heaven, one like a son of man was coming. He reached the Ancient of Days, and they brought him near before Him.
verses.hebrew: חָזֵה הֲוֵית בְּחֶזְוֵי לֵילְיָא וַאֲרוּ עִם־עֲנָנֵי שְׁמַיָּא כְּבַר אֱנָשׁ אָתֵה הֲוָה וְעַד־עַתִּיק יוֹמַיָּא מְטָה וּקְדָמוֹהִי הַקְרְבוּהִי׃

verses.english: Dominion, honor, and kingship were given him, and all peoples, nations, and languages will serve him. His dominion is an everlasting dominion that will not pass away, and his kingdom will not be destroyed.
verses.hebrew: וְלֵהּ יְהִיב שָׁלְטָן וִיקָר וּמַלְכוּ וְכֹל עַמְמַיָּא אֻמַיָּא וְלִשָּׁנַיָּא לֵהּ יִפְלְחוּן שָׁלְטָנֵהּ שָׁלְטָן עָלַם דִּי־לָא יֶעְדֵּה וּמַלְכוּתֵהּ דִּי־לָא תִתְחַבַּל׃

verses.english: As for me, Daniel, my spirit was distressed within its sheath, and the visions of my head alarmed me.
verses.hebrew: אֶתְכְּרִיַּת רוּחִי אֲנָה דָנִיֵּאל בְּגוֹא נִדְנֶה וְחֶזְוֵי רֵאשִׁי יְבַהֲלֻנַּנִי׃

verses.english: I approached one of those standing there and asked him for the truth about all this. He spoke to me and made the interpretation of the matters known to me:
verses.hebrew: קִרְבֵת עַל־חַד מִן־קָאֲמַיָּא וְיַצִּיבָא אֶבְעֵא־מִנֵּהּ עַל־כָּל־דְּנָה וַאֲמַר־לִי וּפְשַׁר מִלַּיָּא יְהוֹדְעִנַּנִי׃

verses.english: ‘These great beasts, four in number, are four kings who will arise from the earth.
verses.hebrew: אִלֵּין חֵיוָתָא רַבְרְבָתָא דִּי אִנִּין אַרְבַּע אַרְבְּעָה מַלְכִין יְקוּמוּן מִן־אַרְעָא׃

verses.english: But the holy ones of the Most High will receive the kingdom and possess the kingdom forever, for the age of ages.’
verses.hebrew: וִיקַבְּלוּן מַלְכוּתָא קַדִּישֵׁי עֶלְיוֹנִין וְיַחְסְנוּן מַלְכוּתָא עַד־עָלְמָא וְעַד עָלַם עָלְמַיָּא׃

verses.english: Then I wanted to know for certain about the fourth beast, so different from all the others and so terrifying, with iron teeth and bronze claws, devouring, crushing, and trampling what remained underfoot,
verses.hebrew: אֱדַיִן צְבִית לְיַצָּבָא עַל־חֵיוְתָא רְבִיעָיְתָא דִּי־הֲוָת שָׁנְיָה מִן־כלהון [כָּלְּהֵין] דְּחִילָה יַתִּירָה שניה [שִׁנַּהּ] דִּי־פַרְזֶל וְטִפְרַיהּ דִּי־נְחָשׁ אָכְלָה מַדֲּקָה וּשְׁאָרָא בְּרַגְלַיהּ רָפְסָה׃

verses.english: and about the ten horns on its head and the other that rose, before which three fell—the horn with eyes and a mouth speaking great things, whose appearance was greater than its companions’.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־קַרְנַיָּא עֲשַׂר דִּי בְרֵאשַׁהּ וְאָחֳרִי דִּי סִלְקַת ונפלו [וּנְפַלָה] מִן־קדמיה [קֳדָמַהּ] תְּלָת וְקַרְנָא דִכֵּן וְעַיְנִין לַהּ וְפֻם מְמַלִּל רַבְרְבָן וְחֶזְוַהּ רַב מִן־חַבְרָתַהּ׃

verses.english: I watched as that horn made war with the holy ones and prevailed over them,
verses.hebrew: חָזֵה הֲוֵית וְקַרְנָא דִכֵּן עָבְדָה קְרָב עִם־קַדִּישִׁין וְיָכְלָה לְהוֹן׃

verses.english: until the Ancient of Days came and judgment was given for the holy ones of the Most High. The time arrived, and the holy ones possessed the kingdom.
verses.hebrew: עַד דִּי־אֲתָה עַתִּיק יוֹמַיָּא וְדִינָא יְהִב לְקַדִּישֵׁי עֶלְיוֹנִין וְזִמְנָא מְטָה וּמַלְכוּתָא הֶחֱסִנוּ קַדִּישִׁין׃

verses.english: He said, ‘The fourth beast will be a fourth kingdom on earth, different from all kingdoms. It will devour the whole earth, trample it, and crush it.
verses.hebrew: כֵּן אֲמַר חֵיוְתָא רְבִיעָיְתָא מַלְכוּ רביעיא [רְבִיעָאָה] תֶּהֱוֵא בְאַרְעָא דִּי תִשְׁנֵא מִן־כָּל־מַלְכְוָתָא וְתֵאכֻל כָּל־אַרְעָא וּתְדוּשִׁנַּהּ וְתַדְּקִנַּהּ׃

verses.english: The ten horns mean that ten kings will arise from that kingdom. Another will arise after them, differing from the former ones, and he will humble three kings.
verses.hebrew: וְקַרְנַיָּא עֲשַׂר מִנַּהּ מַלְכוּתָה עַשְׂרָה מַלְכִין יְקֻמוּן וְאָחֳרָן יְקוּם אַחֲרֵיהוֹן וְהוּא יִשְׁנֵא מִן־קַדְמָיֵא וּתְלָתָה מַלְכִין יְהַשְׁפִּל׃

verses.english: He will speak words against the Most High and wear out the holy ones of the Most High. He will intend to change appointed times and law, and they will be given into his hand for a period, periods, and half a period.
verses.hebrew: וּמִלִּין לְצַד עליא [עִלָּאָה] יְמַלִּל וּלְקַדִּישֵׁי עֶלְיוֹנִין יְבַלֵּא וְיִסְבַּר לְהַשְׁנָיָה זִמְנִין וְדָת וְיִתְיַהֲבוּן בִּידֵהּ עַד־עִדָּן וְעִדָּנִין וּפְלַג עִדָּן׃

verses.english: But the court will sit, and his dominion will be taken away, to be destroyed and annihilated completely.
verses.hebrew: וְדִינָא יִתִּב וְשָׁלְטָנֵהּ יְהַעְדּוֹן לְהַשְׁמָדָה וּלְהוֹבָדָה עַד־סוֹפָא׃

verses.english: The kingdom, dominion, and greatness of the kingdoms under all heaven will be given to the people of the holy ones of the Most High. His kingdom will be an everlasting kingdom, and all dominions will serve and obey him.’
verses.hebrew: וּמַלְכוּתָה וְשָׁלְטָנָא וּרְבוּתָא דִּי מַלְכְוָת תְּחוֹת כָּל־שְׁמַיָּא יְהִיבַת לְעַם קַדִּישֵׁי עֶלְיוֹנִין מַלְכוּתֵהּ מַלְכוּת עָלַם וְכֹל שָׁלְטָנַיָּא לֵהּ יִפְלְחוּן וְיִשְׁתַּמְּעוּן׃

verses.english: Here the account ends. As for me, Daniel, my thoughts greatly alarmed me and my color changed, but I kept the matter in my heart.”
verses.hebrew: עַד־כָּה סוֹפָא דִי־מִלְּתָא אֲנָה דָנִיֵּאל שַׂגִּיא רַעְיוֹנַי יְבַהֲלֻנַּנִי וְזִיוַי יִשְׁתַּנּוֹן עֲלַי וּמִלְּתָא בְּלִבִּי נִטְרֵת׃

verses.english: In the third year of King Belshazzar’s reign, a vision appeared to me, Daniel, after the one that appeared to me at first.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלוֹשׁ לְמַלְכוּת בֵּלְאשַׁצַּר הַמֶּלֶךְ חָזוֹן נִרְאָה אֵלַי אֲנִי דָנִיֵּאל אַחֲרֵי הַנִּרְאָה אֵלַי בַּתְּחִלָּה׃

verses.english: I saw in the vision that, as I looked, I was in Susa the citadel, in the province of Elam. I saw in the vision that I was beside the Ulai watercourse.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶרְאֶה בֶּחָזוֹן וַיְהִי בִּרְאֹתִי וַאֲנִי בְּשׁוּשַׁן הַבִּירָה אֲשֶׁר בְּעֵילָם הַמְּדִינָה וָאֶרְאֶה בֶּחָזוֹן וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי עַל־אוּבַל אוּלָי׃

verses.english: I lifted my eyes and saw a ram standing before the watercourse. It had two horns, and the horns were high, but one was higher than the other, and the higher one rose last.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשָּׂא עֵינַי וָאֶרְאֶה וְהִנֵּה אַיִל אֶחָד עֹמֵד לִפְנֵי הָאֻבָל וְלוֹ קְרָנָיִם וְהַקְּרָנַיִם גְּבֹהוֹת וְהָאַחַת גְּבֹהָה מִן־הַשֵּׁנִית וְהַגְּבֹהָה עֹלָה בָּאַחֲרֹנָה׃

verses.english: I saw the ram charging westward, northward, and southward. No animals could stand before it, and no one could rescue from its power. It did as it pleased and grew great.
verses.hebrew: רָאִיתִי אֶת־הָאַיִל מְנַגֵּחַ יָמָּה וְצָפוֹנָה וָנֶגְבָּה וְכָל־חַיּוֹת לֹא־יַעַמְדוּ לְפָנָיו וְאֵין מַצִּיל מִיָּדוֹ וְעָשָׂה כִרְצֹנוֹ וְהִגְדִּיל׃

verses.english: As I was considering, a male goat came from the west across the face of the whole earth without touching the earth. The goat had a conspicuous horn between its eyes.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי מֵבִין וְהִנֵּה צְפִיר־הָעִזִּים בָּא מִן־הַמַּעֲרָב עַל־פְּנֵי כָל־הָאָרֶץ וְאֵין נוֹגֵעַ בָּאָרֶץ וְהַצָּפִיר קֶרֶן חָזוּת בֵּין עֵינָיו׃

verses.english: It came toward the two-horned ram that I had seen standing before the watercourse and ran at it in the fury of its strength.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא עַד־הָאַיִל בַּעַל הַקְּרָנַיִם אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי עֹמֵד לִפְנֵי הָאֻבָל וַיָּרָץ אֵלָיו בַּחֲמַת כֹּחוֹ׃

verses.english: I saw it reach the ram, become enraged against it, strike the ram, and break its two horns. The ram had no strength to stand before it. The goat threw it to the earth and trampled it, and no one could rescue the ram from its power.
verses.hebrew: וּרְאִיתִיו מַגִּיעַ אֵצֶל הָאַיִל וַיִּתְמַרְמַר אֵלָיו וַיַּךְ אֶת־הָאַיִל וַיְשַׁבֵּר אֶת־שְׁתֵּי קְרָנָיו וְלֹא־הָיָה כֹחַ בָּאַיִל לַעֲמֹד לְפָנָיו וַיַּשְׁלִיכֵהוּ אַרְצָה וַיִּרְמְסֵהוּ וְלֹא־הָיָה מַצִּיל לָאַיִל מִיָּדוֹ׃

verses.english: The male goat grew exceedingly great. But when it became strong, the great horn was broken, and four conspicuous horns rose in its place toward the four winds of heaven.
verses.hebrew: וּצְפִיר הָעִזִּים הִגְדִּיל עַד־מְאֹד וּכְעָצְמוֹ נִשְׁבְּרָה הַקֶּרֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה וַתַּעֲלֶנָה חָזוּת אַרְבַּע תַּחְתֶּיהָ לְאַרְבַּע רוּחוֹת הַשָּׁמָיִם׃

verses.english: From one of them came a horn, small at first, which grew exceedingly toward the south, toward the east, and toward the Beautiful.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הָאַחַת מֵהֶם יָצָא קֶרֶן־אַחַת מִצְּעִירָה וַתִּגְדַּל־יֶתֶר אֶל־הַנֶּגֶב וְאֶל־הַמִּזְרָח וְאֶל־הַצֶּבִי׃

verses.english: It grew as high as heaven’s host, cast some of the host and some of the stars to the earth, and trampled them.
verses.hebrew: וַתִּגְדַּל עַד־צְבָא הַשָּׁמָיִם וַתַּפֵּל אַרְצָה מִן־הַצָּבָא וּמִן־הַכּוֹכָבִים וַתִּרְמְסֵם׃

verses.english: It magnified itself even against the prince of the host. From him the regular offering was taken away, and the foundation of his sanctuary was cast down.
verses.hebrew: וְעַד שַׂר־הַצָּבָא הִגְדִּיל וּמִמֶּנּוּ הרים [הוּרַם] הַתָּמִיד וְהֻשְׁלַךְ מְכוֹן מִקְדָּשׁוֹ׃

verses.english: A host will be given over, along with the regular offering, because of transgression. It cast truth to the earth, acted, and prospered.
verses.hebrew: וְצָבָא תִּנָּתֵן עַל־הַתָּמִיד בְּפָשַׁע וְתַשְׁלֵךְ אֱמֶת אַרְצָה וְעָשְׂתָה וְהִצְלִיחָה׃

verses.english: I heard a holy one speaking, and another holy one said to that particular speaker, “How long is the vision concerning the regular offering and the desolating transgression, the giving over of sanctuary and host to trampling?”
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁמְעָה אֶחָד־קָדוֹשׁ מְדַבֵּר וַיֹּאמֶר אֶחָד קָדוֹשׁ לַפַּלְמוֹנִי הַמְדַבֵּר עַד־מָתַי הֶחָזוֹן הַתָּמִיד וְהַפֶּשַׁע שֹׁמֵם תֵּת וְקֹדֶשׁ וְצָבָא מִרְמָס׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Until evening-morning, two thousand three hundred; then the sanctuary will be vindicated.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי עַד עֶרֶב בֹּקֶר אַלְפַּיִם וּשְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת וְנִצְדַּק קֹדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: When I, Daniel, saw the vision, I sought understanding, and there stood before me one with the appearance of a man.
verses.hebrew: וַיְהִי בִּרְאֹתִי אֲנִי דָנִיֵּאל אֶת־הֶחָזוֹן וָאֲבַקְשָׁה בִינָה וְהִנֵּה עֹמֵד לְנֶגְדִּי כְּמַרְאֵה־גָבֶר׃

verses.english: I heard a human voice between the banks of Ulai, calling, “Gabriel, make this one understand the vision.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁמַע קוֹל־אָדָם בֵּין אוּלָי וַיִּקְרָא וַיֹּאמַר גַּבְרִיאֵל הָבֵן לְהַלָּז אֶת־הַמַּרְאֶה׃

verses.english: He came near where I stood. At his coming I was terrified and fell upon my face. He said to me, “Understand, son of man, for the vision concerns the time of the end.”
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֹא אֵצֶל עָמְדִי וּבְבֹאוֹ נִבְעַתִּי וָאֶפְּלָה עַל־פָּנָי וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי הָבֵן בֶּן־אָדָם כִּי לְעֶת־קֵץ הֶחָזוֹן׃

verses.english: While he spoke with me, I fell into deep sleep with my face to the earth. He touched me and made me stand where I had stood.
verses.hebrew: וּבְדַבְּרוֹ עִמִּי נִרְדַּמְתִּי עַל־פָּנַי אָרְצָה וַיִּגַּע־בִּי וַיַּעֲמִידֵנִי עַל־עָמְדִי׃

verses.english: He said, “Look! I am making known to you what will happen at the latter end of the indignation, for it concerns the appointed time of the end.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הִנְנִי מוֹדִיעֲךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יִהְיֶה בְּאַחֲרִית הַזָּעַם כִּי לְמוֹעֵד קֵץ׃

verses.english: The ram you saw with the two horns represents the kings of Media and Persia.
verses.hebrew: הָאַיִל אֲשֶׁר־רָאִיתָ בַּעַל הַקְּרָנָיִם מַלְכֵי מָדַי וּפָרָס׃

verses.english: The hairy male goat is the king of Greece, and the great horn between its eyes is the first king.
verses.hebrew: וְהַצָּפִיר הַשָּׂעִיר מֶלֶךְ יָוָן וְהַקֶּרֶן הַגְּדוֹלָה אֲשֶׁר בֵּין־עֵינָיו הוּא הַמֶּלֶךְ הָרִאשׁוֹן׃

verses.english: The broken horn and the four that arose in its place mean that four kingdoms will arise from the nation, but not with his strength.
verses.hebrew: וְהַנִּשְׁבֶּרֶת וַתַּעֲמֹדְנָה אַרְבַּע תַּחְתֶּיהָ אַרְבַּע מַלְכֻיוֹת מִגּוֹי יַעֲמֹדְנָה וְלֹא בְכֹחוֹ׃

verses.english: At the latter end of their kingdom, when the transgressors reach their full measure, a king will arise, fierce of face and understanding riddles.
verses.hebrew: וּבְאַחֲרִית מַלְכוּתָם כְּהָתֵם הַפֹּשְׁעִים יַעֲמֹד מֶלֶךְ עַז־פָּנִים וּמֵבִין חִידוֹת׃

verses.english: His strength will grow mighty, though not by his own strength. He will destroy astonishingly, prosper, and act; he will destroy the mighty and the people of the holy ones.
verses.hebrew: וְעָצַם כֹּחוֹ וְלֹא בְכֹחוֹ וְנִפְלָאוֹת יַשְׁחִית וְהִצְלִיחַ וְעָשָׂה וְהִשְׁחִית עֲצוּמִים וְעַם־קְדֹשִׁים׃

verses.english: Through his understanding he will make deceit prosper in his hand. He will magnify himself in his heart and destroy many while they are at ease. He will rise against the prince of princes, but will be broken without a hand.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־שִׂכְלוֹ וְהִצְלִיחַ מִרְמָה בְּיָדוֹ וּבִלְבָבוֹ יַגְדִּיל וּבְשַׁלְוָה יַשְׁחִית רַבִּים וְעַל־שַׂר־שָׂרִים יַעֲמֹד וּבְאֶפֶס יָד יִשָּׁבֵר׃

verses.english: The vision of the evening and the morning that was told is true. But you, close up the vision, for it concerns many days.”
verses.hebrew: וּמַרְאֵה הָעֶרֶב וְהַבֹּקֶר אֲשֶׁר נֶאֱמַר אֱמֶת הוּא וְאַתָּה סְתֹם הֶחָזוֹן כִּי לְיָמִים רַבִּים׃

verses.english: I, Daniel, was overcome and sick for days. Then I rose and did the king’s work, but I was appalled by the vision, and no one understood it.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי דָנִיֵּאל נִהְיֵיתִי וְנֶחֱלֵיתִי יָמִים וָאָקוּם וָאֶעֱשֶׂה אֶת־מְלֶאכֶת הַמֶּלֶךְ וָאֶשְׁתּוֹמֵם עַל־הַמַּרְאֶה וְאֵין מֵבִין׃

verses.english: In the first year of Darius son of Ahasuerus, of Median descent, who had been made king over the kingdom of the Chaldeans,
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת אַחַת לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ בֶּן־אֲחַשְׁוֵרוֹשׁ מִזֶּרַע מָדָי אֲשֶׁר הָמְלַךְ עַל מַלְכוּת כַּשְׂדִּים׃

verses.english: in the first year of his reign, I, Daniel, understood from the books the number of years spoken of in YHWH’s word to Jeremiah the prophet: seventy years to complete Jerusalem’s desolations.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת אַחַת לְמָלְכוֹ אֲנִי דָּנִיֵּאל בִּינֹתִי בַּסְּפָרִים מִסְפַּר הַשָּׁנִים אֲשֶׁר הָיָה דְבַר־יְהוָה אֶל־יִרְמִיָה הַנָּבִיא לְמַלֹּאות לְחָרְבוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם שִׁבְעִים שָׁנָה׃

verses.english: I turned my face toward the Lord God to seek Him with prayer and pleas for mercy, with fasting, sackcloth, and ashes.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְּנָה אֶת־פָּנַי אֶל־אֲדֹנָי הָאֱלֹהִים לְבַקֵּשׁ תְּפִלָּה וְתַחֲנוּנִים בְּצוֹם וְשַׂק וָאֵפֶר׃

verses.english: I prayed to YHWH my God and confessed, saying, “Please, Lord, great and fearsome God, who keeps the covenant and steadfast love for those who love Him and keep His commandments:
verses.hebrew: וָאֶתְפַּלְלָה לַיהוָה אֱלֹהַי וָאֶתְוַדֶּה וָאֹמְרָה אָנָּא אֲדֹנָי הָאֵל הַגָּדוֹל וְהַנּוֹרָא שֹׁמֵר הַבְּרִית וְהַחֶסֶד לְאֹהֲבָיו וּלְשֹׁמְרֵי מִצְוֺתָיו׃

verses.english: we have sinned, done wrong, acted wickedly, and rebelled, turning aside from Your commandments and judgments.
verses.hebrew: חָטָאנוּ וְעָוִינוּ והרשענו [הִרְשַׁעְנוּ] וּמָרָדְנוּ וְסוֹר מִמִּצְוֺתֶךָ וּמִמִּשְׁפָּטֶיךָ׃

verses.english: We have not listened to Your servants the prophets, who spoke in Your name to our kings, our princes, our fathers, and all the people of the land.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמַעְנוּ אֶל־עֲבָדֶיךָ הַנְּבִיאִים אֲשֶׁר דִּבְּרוּ בְּשִׁמְךָ אֶל־מְלָכֵינוּ שָׂרֵינוּ וַאֲבֹתֵינוּ וְאֶל כָּל־עַם הָאָרֶץ׃

verses.english: Righteousness belongs to You, Lord, but shame of face belongs to us, as on this day—to the people of Judah, the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and all Israel, near and far, in all the lands where You drove them because of the unfaithfulness they committed against You.
verses.hebrew: לְךָ אֲדֹנָי הַצְּדָקָה וְלָנוּ בֹּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה לְאִישׁ יְהוּדָה וּלְיוֹשְׁבֵי יְרוּשָׁלִַם וּלְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל הַקְּרֹבִים וְהָרְחֹקִים בְּכָל־הָאֲרָצוֹת אֲשֶׁר הִדַּחְתָּם שָׁם בְּמַעֲלָם אֲשֶׁר מָעֲלוּ־בָךְ׃

verses.english: YHWH, shame of face belongs to us, to our kings, princes, and fathers, because we have sinned against You.
verses.hebrew: יְהוָה לָנוּ בֹּשֶׁת הַפָּנִים לִמְלָכֵינוּ לְשָׂרֵינוּ וְלַאֲבֹתֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר חָטָאנוּ לָךְ׃

verses.english: To the Lord our God belong compassion and forgiveness, for we have rebelled against Him.
verses.hebrew: לַאדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ הָרַחֲמִים וְהַסְּלִחוֹת כִּי מָרַדְנוּ בּוֹ׃

verses.english: We have not listened to the voice of YHWH our God, to walk in His teachings that He set before us through His servants the prophets.
verses.hebrew: וְלֹא שָׁמַעְנוּ בְּקוֹל יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָלֶכֶת בְּתוֹרֹתָיו אֲשֶׁר נָתַן לְפָנֵינוּ בְּיַד עֲבָדָיו הַנְּבִיאִים׃

verses.english: All Israel has transgressed Your teaching and turned aside, refusing to listen to Your voice. The curse and oath written in the teaching of Moses, God’s servant, have been poured out upon us, because we sinned against Him.
verses.hebrew: וְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵל עָבְרוּ אֶת־תּוֹרָתֶךָ וְסוֹר לְבִלְתִּי שְׁמוֹעַ בְּקֹלֶךָ וַתִּתַּךְ עָלֵינוּ הָאָלָה וְהַשְּׁבֻעָה אֲשֶׁר כְּתוּבָה בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה עֶבֶד־הָאֱלֹהִים כִּי חָטָאנוּ לוֹ׃

verses.english: He confirmed His words spoken against us and against our judges who judged us, by bringing great calamity upon us. Under all heaven nothing has been done like what was done in Jerusalem.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּקֶם אֶת־דבריו [דְּבָרוֹ ] אֲשֶׁר־דִּבֶּר עָלֵינוּ וְעַל שֹׁפְטֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר שְׁפָטוּנוּ לְהָבִיא עָלֵינוּ רָעָה גְדֹלָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נֶעֶשְׂתָה תַּחַת כָּל־הַשָּׁמַיִם כַּאֲשֶׁר נֶעֶשְׂתָה בִּירוּשָׁלִָם׃

verses.english: As written in Moses’ teaching, all this calamity came upon us. Yet we did not entreat the favor of YHWH our God by turning from our iniquity and gaining understanding of Your truth.
verses.hebrew: כַּאֲשֶׁר כָּתוּב בְּתוֹרַת מֹשֶׁה אֵת כָּל־הָרָעָה הַזֹּאת בָּאָה עָלֵינוּ וְלֹא־חִלִּינוּ אֶת־פְּנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ לָשׁוּב מֵעֲוֺנֵנוּ וּלְהַשְׂכִּיל בַּאֲמִתֶּךָ׃

verses.english: YHWH watched over the calamity and brought it upon us, for YHWH our God is righteous in all His works that He has done, and we did not listen to His voice.
verses.hebrew: וַיִּשְׁקֹד יְהוָה עַל־הָרָעָה וַיְבִיאֶהָ עָלֵינוּ כִּי־צַדִּיק יְהוָה אֱלֹהֵינוּ עַל־כָּל־מַעֲשָׂיו אֲשֶׁר עָשָׂה וְלֹא שָׁמַעְנוּ בְּקֹלוֹ׃

verses.english: Now, Lord our God, who brought Your people out of Egypt with a strong hand and made Yourself a name as on this day: we have sinned and acted wickedly.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֲדֹנָי אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֲשֶׁר הוֹצֵאתָ אֶת־עַמְּךָ מֵאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם בְּיָד חֲזָקָה וַתַּעַשׂ־לְךָ שֵׁם כַּיּוֹם הַזֶּה חָטָאנוּ רָשָׁעְנוּ׃

verses.english: Lord, according to all Your righteous deeds, please turn Your anger and wrath away from Your city Jerusalem, Your holy mountain. Because of our sins and our fathers’ iniquities, Jerusalem and Your people have become a reproach to all around us.
verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי כְּכָל־צִדְקֹתֶךָ יָשָׁב־נָא אַפְּךָ וַחֲמָתְךָ מֵעִירְךָ יְרוּשָׁלִַם הַר־קָדְשֶׁךָ כִּי בַחֲטָאֵינוּ וּבַעֲוֺנוֹת אֲבֹתֵינוּ יְרוּשָׁלִַם וְעַמְּךָ לְחֶרְפָּה לְכָל־סְבִיבֹתֵינוּ׃

verses.english: Now, our God, hear Your servant’s prayer and his pleas for mercy. Make Your face shine upon Your desolate sanctuary, for the Lord’s sake.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה שְׁמַע אֱלֹהֵינוּ אֶל־תְּפִלַּת עַבְדְּךָ וְאֶל־תַּחֲנוּנָיו וְהָאֵר פָּנֶיךָ עַל־מִקְדָּשְׁךָ הַשָּׁמֵם לְמַעַן אֲדֹנָי׃

verses.english: Incline Your ear, my God, and hear. Open Your eyes and see our desolations and the city over which Your name is called. We do not lay our pleas before You because of our righteous deeds, but because of Your abundant compassion.
verses.hebrew: הַטֵּה אֱלֹהַי אָזְנְךָ וּשֲׁמָע פקחה [פְּקַח] עֵינֶיךָ וּרְאֵה שֹׁמְמֹתֵינוּ וְהָעִיר אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא שִׁמְךָ עָלֶיהָ כִּי לֹא עַל־צִדְקֹתֵינוּ אֲנַחְנוּ מַפִּילִים תַּחֲנוּנֵינוּ לְפָנֶיךָ כִּי עַל־רַחֲמֶיךָ הָרַבִּים׃

verses.english: Lord, hear! Lord, forgive! Lord, attend and act! Do not delay, for Your own sake, my God, because Your name is called over Your city and Your people.”
verses.hebrew: אֲדֹנָי שְׁמָעָה אֲדֹנָי סְלָחָה אֲדֹנָי הַקֲשִׁיבָה וַעֲשֵׂה אַל־תְּאַחַר לְמַעֲנְךָ אֱלֹהַי כִּי־שִׁמְךָ נִקְרָא עַל־עִירְךָ וְעַל־עַמֶּךָ׃

verses.english: While I was still speaking, praying, confessing my sin and the sin of my people Israel, and laying my plea before YHWH my God concerning my God’s holy mountain,
verses.hebrew: וְעוֹד אֲנִי מְדַבֵּר וּמִתְפַּלֵּל וּמִתְוַדֶּה חַטָּאתִי וְחַטַּאת עַמִּי יִשְׂרָאֵל וּמַפִּיל תְּחִנָּתִי לִפְנֵי יְהוָה אֱלֹהַי עַל הַר־קֹדֶשׁ אֱלֹהָי׃

verses.english: while I was still speaking in prayer, the man Gabriel, whom I had seen in the vision at first, came to me in swift flight about the time of the evening offering.
verses.hebrew: וְעוֹד אֲנִי מְדַבֵּר בַּתְּפִלָּה וְהָאִישׁ גַּבְרִיאֵל אֲשֶׁר רָאִיתִי בֶחָזוֹן בַּתְּחִלָּה מֻעָף בִּיעָף נֹגֵעַ אֵלַי כְּעֵת מִנְחַת־עָרֶב׃

verses.english: He gave me understanding, spoke with me, and said, “Daniel, I have now come out to give you insight and understanding.
verses.hebrew: וַיָּבֶן וַיְדַבֵּר עִמִּי וַיֹּאמַר דָּנִיֵּאל עַתָּה יָצָאתִי לְהַשְׂכִּילְךָ בִינָה׃

verses.english: At the beginning of your pleas, a word went out, and I have come to declare it, for you are treasured. Consider the word and understand the vision.
verses.hebrew: בִּתְחִלַּת תַּחֲנוּנֶיךָ יָצָא דָבָר וַאֲנִי בָּאתִי לְהַגִּיד כִּי חֲמוּדוֹת אָתָּה וּבִין בַּדָּבָר וְהָבֵן בַּמַּרְאֶה׃

verses.english: Seventy weeks have been decreed for your people and your holy city: to restrain transgression, seal up sins, make atonement for iniquity, bring everlasting righteousness, seal vision and prophet, and anoint a holy of holies.
verses.hebrew: שָׁבֻעִים שִׁבְעִים נֶחְתַּךְ עַל־עַמְּךָ וְעַל־עִיר קָדְשֶׁךָ לְכַלֵּא הַפֶּשַׁע ולחתם [וּלְהָתֵם] חטאות [חַטָּאת] וּלְכַפֵּר עָוֺן וּלְהָבִיא צֶדֶק עֹלָמִים וְלַחְתֹּם חָזוֹן וְנָבִיא וְלִמְשֹׁחַ קֹדֶשׁ קָדָשִׁים׃

verses.english: Know and understand: from the issuing of a word to restore and rebuild Jerusalem until an anointed leader, there will be seven weeks. For sixty-two weeks it will be restored and rebuilt, with square and moat, but in troubled times.
verses.hebrew: וְתֵדַע וְתַשְׂכֵּל מִן־מֹצָא דָבָר לְהָשִׁיב וְלִבְנוֹת יְרוּשָׁלִַם עַד־מָשִׁיחַ נָגִיד שָׁבֻעִים שִׁבְעָה וְשָׁבֻעִים שִׁשִּׁים וּשְׁנַיִם תָּשׁוּב וְנִבְנְתָה רְחוֹב וְחָרוּץ וּבְצוֹק הָעִתִּים׃

verses.english: After the sixty-two weeks, an anointed one will be cut off and have nothing. The people of a coming ruler will destroy the city and sanctuary. Its end will be with a flood; until the end there will be war, with desolations decreed.
verses.hebrew: וְאַחֲרֵי הַשָּׁבֻעִים שִׁשִּׁים וּשְׁנַיִם יִכָּרֵת מָשִׁיחַ וְאֵין לוֹ וְהָעִיר וְהַקֹּדֶשׁ יַשְׁחִית עַם נָגִיד הַבָּא וְקִצּוֹ בַשֶּׁטֶף וְעַד קֵץ מִלְחָמָה נֶחֱרֶצֶת שֹׁמֵמוֹת׃

verses.english: He will make a covenant strong for many for one week, and halfway through the week he will stop sacrifice and offering. Upon a wing of abominations will be a desolator, until the decreed complete destruction is poured upon the desolator.”
verses.hebrew: וְהִגְבִּיר בְּרִית לָרַבִּים שָׁבוּעַ אֶחָד וַחֲצִי הַשָּׁבוּעַ יַשְׁבִּית זֶבַח וּמִנְחָה וְעַל כְּנַף שִׁקּוּצִים מְשֹׁמֵם וְעַד־כָּלָה וְנֶחֱרָצָה תִּתַּךְ עַל־שֹׁמֵם׃

verses.english: In the third year of Cyrus, king of Persia, a word was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar. The word was true and concerned great conflict. He understood the word and had understanding of the vision.
verses.hebrew: בִּשְׁנַת שָׁלוֹשׁ לְכוֹרֶשׁ מֶלֶךְ פָּרַס דָּבָר נִגְלָה לְדָנִיֵּאל אֲשֶׁר־נִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר וֶאֱמֶת הַדָּבָר וְצָבָא גָדוֹל וּבִין אֶת־הַדָּבָר וּבִינָה לוֹ בַּמַּרְאֶה׃

verses.english: In those days I, Daniel, was mourning for three weeks of days.
verses.hebrew: בַּיָּמִים הָהֵם אֲנִי דָנִיֵּאל הָיִיתִי מִתְאַבֵּל שְׁלֹשָׁה שָׁבֻעִים יָמִים׃

verses.english: I ate no desirable food. Meat and wine did not enter my mouth, and I did not anoint myself at all until the three weeks of days were completed.
verses.hebrew: לֶחֶם חֲמֻדוֹת לֹא אָכַלְתִּי וּבָשָׂר וָיַיִן לֹא־בָא אֶל־פִּי וְסוֹךְ לֹא־סָכְתִּי עַד־מְלֹאת שְׁלֹשֶׁת שָׁבֻעִים יָמִים׃

verses.english: On the twenty-fourth day of the first month, I was beside the great river, the Tigris.
verses.hebrew: וּבְיוֹם עֶשְׂרִים וְאַרְבָּעָה לַחֹדֶשׁ הָרִאשׁוֹן וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי עַל יַד הַנָּהָר הַגָּדוֹל הוּא חִדָּקֶל׃

verses.english: I lifted my eyes and looked, and there was a man clothed in linen, his waist girded with gold from Uphaz.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשָּׂא אֶת־עֵינַי וָאֵרֶא וְהִנֵּה אִישׁ־אֶחָד לָבוּשׁ בַּדִּים וּמָתְנָיו חֲגֻרִים בְּכֶתֶם אוּפָז׃

verses.english: His body was like a tarshish stone, his face like the appearance of lightning, his eyes like flaming torches, his arms and feet like polished bronze, and the sound of his words like the sound of a multitude.
verses.hebrew: וּגְוִיָּתוֹ כְתַרְשִׁישׁ וּפָנָיו כְּמַרְאֵה בָרָק וְעֵינָיו כְּלַפִּידֵי אֵשׁ וּזְרֹעֹתָיו וּמַרְגְּלֹתָיו כְּעֵין נְחֹשֶׁת קָלָל וְקוֹל דְּבָרָיו כְּקוֹל הָמוֹן׃

verses.english: I, Daniel, alone saw the vision. The men with me did not see it, but great trembling fell upon them, and they fled to hide.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאִיתִי אֲנִי דָנִיֵּאל לְבַדִּי אֶת־הַמַּרְאָה וְהָאֲנָשִׁים אֲשֶׁר הָיוּ עִמִּי לֹא רָאוּ אֶת־הַמַּרְאָה אֲבָל חֲרָדָה גְדֹלָה נָפְלָה עֲלֵיהֶם וַיִּבְרְחוּ בְּהֵחָבֵא׃

verses.english: I was left alone and saw this great vision. No strength remained in me; my splendor was changed to ruin, and I retained no strength.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי נִשְׁאַרְתִּי לְבַדִּי וָאֶרְאֶה אֶת־הַמַּרְאָה הַגְּדֹלָה הַזֹּאת וְלֹא נִשְׁאַר־בִּי כֹּח וְהוֹדִי נֶהְפַּךְ עָלַי לְמַשְׁחִית וְלֹא עָצַרְתִּי כֹּחַ׃

verses.english: I heard the sound of his words, and when I heard their sound, I fell into deep sleep upon my face, with my face to the earth.
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁמַע אֶת־קוֹל דְּבָרָיו וּכְשָׁמְעִי אֶת־קוֹל דְּבָרָיו וַאֲנִי הָיִיתִי נִרְדָּם עַל־פָּנַי וּפָנַי אָרְצָה׃

verses.english: A hand touched me and set me trembling on my knees and the palms of my hands.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה־יָד נָגְעָה בִּי וַתְּנִיעֵנִי עַל־בִּרְכַּי וְכַפּוֹת יָדָי׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Daniel, treasured man, understand the words I am speaking to you and stand where you are, for I have now been sent to you.” As he spoke this word to me, I stood trembling.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי דָּנִיֵּאל אִישׁ־חֲמֻדוֹת הָבֵן בַּדְּבָרִים אֲשֶׁר אָנֹכִי דֹבֵר אֵלֶיךָ וַעֲמֹד עַל־עָמְדֶךָ כִּי עַתָּה שֻׁלַּחְתִּי אֵלֶיךָ וּבְדַבְּרוֹ עִמִּי אֶת־הַדָּבָר הַזֶּה עָמַדְתִּי מַרְעִיד׃

verses.english: He said to me, “Do not fear, Daniel. From the first day you set your heart to understand and humble yourself before your God, your words were heard, and I have come because of your words.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אֵלַי אַל־תִּירָא דָנִיֵּאל כִּי מִן־הַיּוֹם הָרִאשׁוֹן אֲשֶׁר נָתַתָּ אֶת־לִבְּךָ לְהָבִין וּלְהִתְעַנּוֹת לִפְנֵי אֱלֹהֶיךָ נִשְׁמְעוּ דְבָרֶיךָ וַאֲנִי־בָאתִי בִּדְבָרֶיךָ׃

verses.english: The prince of the kingdom of Persia stood against me for twenty-one days. Then Michael, one of the chief princes, came to help me, and I remained there beside the kings of Persia.
verses.hebrew: וְשַׂר מַלְכוּת פָּרַס עֹמֵד לְנֶגְדִּי עֶשְׂרִים וְאֶחָד יוֹם וְהִנֵּה מִיכָאֵל אַחַד הַשָּׂרִים הָרִאשֹׁנִים בָּא לְעָזְרֵנִי וַאֲנִי נוֹתַרְתִּי שָׁם אֵצֶל מַלְכֵי פָרָס׃

verses.english: I have come to make you understand what will happen to your people in the latter days, for the vision still concerns days to come.”
verses.hebrew: וּבָאתִי לַהֲבִינְךָ אֵת אֲשֶׁר־יִקְרָה לְעַמְּךָ בְּאַחֲרִית הַיָּמִים כִּי־עוֹד חָזוֹן לַיָּמִים׃

verses.english: As he spoke these words with me, I turned my face toward the earth and became speechless.
verses.hebrew: וּבְדַבְּרוֹ עִמִּי כַּדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה נָתַתִּי פָנַי אַרְצָה וְנֶאֱלָמְתִּי׃

verses.english: Then one in the likeness of human beings touched my lips. I opened my mouth and spoke to the one standing before me: “My lord, because of the vision, my pangs have turned upon me, and I have retained no strength.
verses.hebrew: וְהִנֵּה כִּדְמוּת בְּנֵי אָדָם נֹגֵעַ עַל־שְׂפָתָי וָאֶפְתַּח־פִּי וָאֲדַבְּרָה וָאֹמְרָה אֶל־הָעֹמֵד לְנֶגְדִּי אֲדֹנִי בַּמַּרְאָה נֶהֶפְכוּ צִירַי עָלַי וְלֹא עָצַרְתִּי כֹּחַ׃

verses.english: How can this servant of my lord speak with my lord here? From this moment no strength remains in me, and no breath is left in me.”
verses.hebrew: וְהֵיךְ יוּכַל עֶבֶד אֲדֹנִי זֶה לְדַבֵּר עִם־אֲדֹנִי זֶה וַאֲנִי מֵעַתָּה לֹא־יַעֲמָד־בִּי כֹחַ וּנְשָׁמָה לֹא נִשְׁאֲרָה־בִי׃

verses.english: Again one with a human appearance touched me and strengthened me.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּסֶף וַיִּגַּע־בִּי כְּמַרְאֵה אָדָם וַיְחַזְּקֵנִי׃

verses.english: He said, “Do not fear, treasured man. Peace to you! Be strong, be strong!” As he spoke with me, I grew strong and said, “Let my lord speak, for you have strengthened me.”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר אַל־תִּירָא אִישׁ־חֲמֻדוֹת שָׁלוֹם לָךְ חֲזַק וַחֲזָק וּבְדַבְּרוֹ עִמִּי הִתְחַזַּקְתִּי וָאֹמְרָה יְדַבֵּר אֲדֹנִי כִּי חִזַּקְתָּנִי׃

verses.english: He said, “Do you know why I have come to you? Now I will return to fight the prince of Persia. When I go out, the prince of Greece will come.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר הֲיָדַעְתָּ לָמָּה־בָּאתִי אֵלֶיךָ וְעַתָּה אָשׁוּב לְהִלָּחֵם עִם־שַׂר פָּרָס וַאֲנִי יוֹצֵא וְהִנֵּה שַׂר־יָוָן בָּא׃

verses.english: But I will declare to you what is inscribed in the writing of truth. No one stands firmly with me against these except Michael, your prince.
verses.hebrew: אֲבָל אַגִּיד לְךָ אֶת־הָרָשׁוּם בִּכְתָב אֱמֶת וְאֵין אֶחָד מִתְחַזֵּק עִמִּי עַל־אֵלֶּה כִּי אִם־מִיכָאֵל שַׂרְכֶם׃

verses.english: As for me, in the first year of Darius the Mede, I stood to strengthen and defend him.
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי בִּשְׁנַת אַחַת לְדָרְיָוֶשׁ הַמָּדִי עָמְדִי לְמַחֲזִיק וּלְמָעוֹז לוֹ׃

verses.english: Now I will declare the truth to you. Three more kings will arise for Persia, and a fourth will gain far greater riches than all of them. When he grows strong through his riches, he will stir up everything against the kingdom of Greece.
verses.hebrew: וְעַתָּה אֱמֶת אַגִּיד לָךְ הִנֵּה־עוֹד שְׁלֹשָׁה מְלָכִים עֹמְדִים לְפָרַס וְהָרְבִיעִי יַעֲשִׁיר עֹשֶׁר־גָּדוֹל מִכֹּל וּכְחֶזְקָתוֹ בְעָשְׁרוֹ יָעִיר הַכֹּל אֵת מַלְכוּת יָוָן׃

verses.english: A mighty king will arise, rule with great dominion, and do as he pleases.
verses.hebrew: וְעָמַד מֶלֶךְ גִּבּוֹר וּמָשַׁל מִמְשָׁל רַב וְעָשָׂה כִּרְצוֹנוֹ׃

verses.english: When he has arisen, his kingdom will be broken and divided toward the four winds of heaven, but not to his descendants or according to the dominion with which he ruled. His kingdom will be uprooted and given to others besides these.
verses.hebrew: וּכְעָמְדוֹ תִּשָּׁבֵר מַלְכוּתוֹ וְתֵחָץ לְאַרְבַּע רוּחוֹת הַשָּׁמָיִם וְלֹא לְאַחֲרִיתוֹ וְלֹא כְמָשְׁלוֹ אֲשֶׁר מָשָׁל כִּי תִנָּתֵשׁ מַלְכוּתוֹ וְלַאֲחֵרִים מִלְּבַד־אֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: The king of the south will grow strong, but one of his princes will become stronger than he and rule; his dominion will be a great dominion.
verses.hebrew: וְיֶחֱזַק מֶלֶךְ־הַנֶּגֶב וּמִן־שָׂרָיו וְיֶחֱזַק עָלָיו וּמָשָׁל מִמְשָׁל רַב מֶמְשַׁלְתּוֹ׃

verses.english: After some years they will join together. The daughter of the king of the south will come to the king of the north to make an equitable agreement. But she will not retain the strength of her arm, and neither he nor his arm will stand. She will be handed over, along with those who brought her, the one who begot her, and the one who supported her in those times.
verses.hebrew: וּלְקֵץ שָׁנִים יִתְחַבָּרוּ וּבַת מֶלֶךְ־הַנֶּגֶב תָּבוֹא אֶל־מֶלֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן לַעֲשׂוֹת מֵישָׁרִים וְלֹא־תַעְצֹר כּוֹחַ הַזְּרוֹעַ וְלֹא יַעֲמֹד וּזְרֹעוֹ וְתִנָּתֵן הִיא וּמְבִיאֶיהָ וְהַיֹּלְדָהּ וּמַחֲזִקָהּ בָּעִתִּים׃

verses.english: A shoot from her roots will arise in his place, come against the army, enter the northern king’s stronghold, act against them, and prevail.
verses.hebrew: וְעָמַד מִנֵּצֶר שָׁרָשֶׁיהָ כַּנּוֹ וְיָבֹא אֶל־הַחַיִל וְיָבֹא בְּמָעוֹז מֶלֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן וְעָשָׂה בָהֶם וְהֶחֱזִיק׃

verses.english: He will also carry their gods, their cast images, and their precious vessels of silver and gold captive to Egypt. For years he will stand apart from the king of the north.
verses.hebrew: וְגַם אֱ‍לֹהֵיהֶם עִם־נְסִכֵיהֶם עִם־כְּלֵי חֶמְדָּתָם כֶּסֶף וְזָהָב בַּשְּׁבִי יָבִא מִצְרָיִם וְהוּא שָׁנִים יַעֲמֹד מִמֶּלֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן׃

verses.english: He will enter the kingdom of the king of the south, then return to his own land.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא בְּמַלְכוּת מֶלֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב וְשָׁב אֶל־אַדְמָתוֹ׃

verses.english: His sons will wage war and gather a multitude of great forces. He will come on, flood through, and pass over; he will return and wage war as far as his stronghold.
verses.hebrew: ובנו [וּבָנָיו] יִתְגָּרוּ וְאָסְפוּ הֲמוֹן חֲיָלִים רַבִּים וּבָא בוֹא וְשָׁטַף וְעָבָר וְיָשֹׁב ויתגרו [וְיִתְגָּרֶה] עַד־מעזה [מָעֻזּוֹ׃]

verses.english: The king of the south will become enraged, go out, and fight with him, the king of the north. The latter will raise a great multitude, but the multitude will be given into his opponent’s hand.
verses.hebrew: וְיִתְמַרְמַר מֶלֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב וְיָצָא וְנִלְחַם עִמּוֹ עִם־מֶלֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן וְהֶעֱמִיד הָמוֹן רָב וְנִתַּן הֶהָמוֹן בְּיָדוֹ׃

verses.english: When the multitude is carried away, his heart will be lifted up. He will fell tens of thousands, yet will not remain strong.
verses.hebrew: וְנִשָּׂא הֶהָמוֹן ירום [וְרָם] לְבָבוֹ וְהִפִּיל רִבֹּאוֹת וְלֹא יָעוֹז׃

verses.english: The king of the north will return and raise a multitude greater than the first. After the appointed span of years he will surely come with a great army and abundant resources.
verses.hebrew: וְשָׁב מֶלֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן וְהֶעֱמִיד הָמוֹן רַב מִן־הָרִאשׁוֹן וּלְקֵץ הָעִתִּים שָׁנִים יָבוֹא בוֹא בְּחַיִל גָּדוֹל וּבִרְכוּשׁ רָב׃

verses.english: In those times many will rise against the king of the south. Violent men of your people will lift themselves up to establish the vision, but they will stumble.
verses.hebrew: וּבָעִתִּים הָהֵם רַבִּים יַעַמְדוּ עַל־מֶלֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב וּבְנֵי פָּרִיצֵי עַמְּךָ יִנַּשְּׂאוּ לְהַעֲמִיד חָזוֹן וְנִכְשָׁלוּ׃

verses.english: The king of the north will come, heap up a siege mound, and capture a fortified city. The forces of the south will not stand, nor its chosen troops; there will be no strength to stand.
verses.hebrew: וְיָבֹא מֶלֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן וְיִשְׁפֹּךְ סוֹלֲלָה וְלָכַד עִיר מִבְצָרוֹת וּזְרֹעוֹת הַנֶּגֶב לֹא יַעֲמֹדוּ וְעַם מִבְחָרָיו וְאֵין כֹּחַ לַעֲמֹד׃

verses.english: The one coming against him will do as he pleases, and none will stand before him. He will stand in the Beautiful Land, with destruction in his hand.
verses.hebrew: וְיַעַשׂ הַבָּא אֵלָיו כִּרְצוֹנוֹ וְאֵין עוֹמֵד לְפָנָיו וְיַעֲמֹד בְּאֶרֶץ־הַצְּבִי וְכָלָה בְיָדוֹ׃

verses.english: He will set his face to come with the strength of his whole kingdom, bringing equitable terms with him, and will act. He will give him a daughter of women to destroy her, but she will not stand or be for him.
verses.hebrew: וְיָשֵׂם פָּנָיו לָבוֹא בְּתֹקֶף כָּל־מַלְכוּתוֹ וִישָׁרִים עִמּוֹ וְעָשָׂה וּבַת הַנָּשִׁים יִתֶּן־לוֹ לְהַשְׁחִיתָהּ וְלֹא תַעֲמֹד וְלֹא־לוֹ תִהְיֶה׃

verses.english: He will turn his face toward the coastlands and capture many. But a commander will end his insolence; indeed, he will turn his insolence back upon him.
verses.hebrew: וישב [וְיָשֵׂם ] פָּנָיו לְאִיִּים וְלָכַד רַבִּים וְהִשְׁבִּית קָצִין חֶרְפָּתוֹ לוֹ בִּלְתִּי חֶרְפָּתוֹ יָשִׁיב לוֹ׃

verses.english: He will turn his face toward the strongholds of his own land, but stumble, fall, and be found no more.
verses.hebrew: וְיָשֵׁב פָּנָיו לְמָעוּזֵּי אַרְצוֹ וְנִכְשַׁל וְנָפַל וְלֹא יִמָּצֵא׃

verses.english: In his place will arise one who sends an exactor through the kingdom’s splendor. Within a few days he will be broken, but not in anger or battle.
verses.hebrew: וְעָמַד עַל־כַּנּוֹ מַעֲבִיר נוֹגֵשׂ הֶדֶר מַלְכוּת וּבְיָמִים אֲחָדִים יִשָּׁבֵר וְלֹא בְאַפַּיִם וְלֹא בְמִלְחָמָה׃

verses.english: In his place will arise a despised person to whom royal majesty has not been given. He will come in quietly and seize the kingdom through smooth dealings.
verses.hebrew: וְעָמַד עַל־כַּנּוֹ נִבְזֶה וְלֹא־נָתְנוּ עָלָיו הוֹד מַלְכוּת וּבָא בְשַׁלְוָה וְהֶחֱזִיק מַלְכוּת בַּחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת׃

verses.english: The overwhelming forces will be swept away before him and broken, and so will a leader of the covenant.
verses.hebrew: וּזְרֹעוֹת הַשֶּׁטֶף יִשָּׁטְפוּ מִלְּפָנָיו וְיִשָּׁבֵרוּ וְגַם נְגִיד בְּרִית׃

verses.english: After an alliance is made with him, he will act deceitfully; he will rise and grow strong with a small nation.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הִתְחַבְּרוּת אֵלָיו יַעֲשֶׂה מִרְמָה וְעָלָה וְעָצַם בִּמְעַט־גּוֹי׃

verses.english: He will enter quietly into the richest parts of a province and do what neither his fathers nor his fathers’ fathers did. He will scatter plunder, spoil, and possessions among them, and devise plans against fortresses, but only for a time.
verses.hebrew: בְּשַׁלְוָה וּבְמִשְׁמַנֵּי מְדִינָה יָבוֹא וְעָשָׂה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־עָשׂוּ אֲבֹתָיו וַאֲבוֹת אֲבֹתָיו בִּזָּה וְשָׁלָל וּרְכוּשׁ לָהֶם יִבְזוֹר וְעַל מִבְצָרִים יְחַשֵּׁב מַחְשְׁבֹתָיו וְעַד־עֵת׃

verses.english: He will stir his strength and heart against the king of the south with a great army. The king of the south will wage war with an exceedingly great and mighty army, but will not stand, because plans will be devised against him.
verses.hebrew: וְיָעֵר כֹּחוֹ וּלְבָבוֹ עַל־מֶלֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב בְּחַיִל גָּדוֹל וּמֶלֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב יִתְגָּרֶה לַמִּלְחָמָה בְּחַיִל־גָּדוֹל וְעָצוּם עַד־מְאֹד וְלֹא יַעֲמֹד כִּי־יַחְשְׁבוּ עָלָיו מַחֲשָׁבוֹת׃

verses.english: Those who eat his choice food will break him. His army will sweep on, and many will fall slain.
verses.hebrew: וְאֹכְלֵי פַת־בָּגוֹ יִשְׁבְּרוּהוּ וְחֵילוֹ יִשְׁטוֹף וְנָפְלוּ חֲלָלִים רַבִּים׃

verses.english: The two kings will set their hearts on evil and speak lies at one table, but it will not succeed, for the end still awaits the appointed time.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁנֵיהֶם הַמְּלָכִים לְבָבָם לְמֵרָע וְעַל־שֻׁלְחָן אֶחָד כָּזָב יְדַבֵּרוּ וְלֹא תִצְלָח כִּי־עוֹד קֵץ לַמּוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: He will return to his land with great possessions, his heart set against the holy covenant. He will act and return to his own land.
verses.hebrew: וְיָשֹׁב אַרְצוֹ בִּרְכוּשׁ גָּדוֹל וּלְבָבוֹ עַל־בְּרִית קֹדֶשׁ וְעָשָׂה וְשָׁב לְאַרְצוֹ׃

verses.english: At the appointed time he will return and enter the south, but this latter time will not be like the first.
verses.hebrew: לַמּוֹעֵד יָשׁוּב וּבָא בַנֶּגֶב וְלֹא־תִהְיֶה כָרִאשֹׁנָה וְכָאַחֲרֹנָה׃

verses.english: Ships of Kittim will come against him, and he will be disheartened. He will turn back, rage against the holy covenant, and act. He will return and give attention to those who abandon the holy covenant.
verses.hebrew: וּבָאוּ בוֹ צִיִּים כִּתִּים וְנִכְאָה וְשָׁב וְזָעַם עַל־בְּרִית־קוֹדֶשׁ וְעָשָׂה וְשָׁב וְיָבֵן עַל־עֹזְבֵי בְּרִית קֹדֶשׁ׃

verses.english: Forces from him will arise, profane the sanctuary-fortress, remove the regular offering, and set up the desolating abomination.
verses.hebrew: וּזְרֹעִים מִמֶּנּוּ יַעֲמֹדוּ וְחִלְּלוּ הַמִּקְדָּשׁ הַמָּעוֹז וְהֵסִירוּ הַתָּמִיד וְנָתְנוּ הַשִּׁקּוּץ מְשׁוֹמֵם׃

verses.english: He will corrupt those who act wickedly against the covenant through smooth words, but the people who know their God will be strong and act.
verses.hebrew: וּמַרְשִׁיעֵי בְרִית יַחֲנִיף בַּחֲלַקּוֹת וְעַם יֹדְעֵי אֱלֹהָיו יַחֲזִקוּ וְעָשׂוּ׃

verses.english: The insightful among the people will give understanding to many, but they will stumble by sword and flame, captivity and plunder, for days.
verses.hebrew: וּמַשְׂכִּילֵי עָם יָבִינוּ לָרַבִּים וְנִכְשְׁלוּ בְּחֶרֶב וּבְלֶהָבָה בִּשְׁבִי וּבְבִזָּה יָמִים׃

verses.english: When they stumble, they will receive a little help, and many will join them with smooth pretenses.
verses.hebrew: וּבְהִכָּשְׁלָם יֵעָזְרוּ עֵזֶר מְעָט וְנִלְווּ עֲלֵיהֶם רַבִּים בַּחֲלַקְלַקּוֹת׃

verses.english: Some of the insightful will stumble, to refine, purify, and whiten them until the time of the end, for the appointed time is still to come.
verses.hebrew: וּמִן־הַמַּשְׂכִּילִים יִכָּשְׁלוּ לִצְרוֹף בָּהֶם וּלְבָרֵר וְלַלְבֵּן עַד־עֵת קֵץ כִּי־עוֹד לַמּוֹעֵד׃

verses.english: The king will do as he pleases, exalt and magnify himself above every god, and speak astonishing things against the God of gods. He will prosper until the indignation is completed, for what has been decreed will be done.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה כִרְצוֹנוֹ הַמֶּלֶךְ וְיִתְרוֹמֵם וְיִתְגַּדֵּל עַל־כָּל־אֵל וְעַל אֵל אֵלִים יְדַבֵּר נִפְלָאוֹת וְהִצְלִיחַ עַד־כָּלָה זַעַם כִּי נֶחֱרָצָה נֶעֱשָׂתָה׃

verses.english: He will pay no attention to his fathers’ gods, to the desire of women, or to any god, for he will magnify himself above all.
verses.hebrew: וְעַל־אֱלֹהֵי אֲבֹתָיו לֹא יָבִין וְעַל־חֶמְדַּת נָשִׁים וְעַל־כָּל־אֱלוֹהַּ לֹא יָבִין כִּי עַל־כֹּל יִתְגַּדָּל׃

verses.english: Instead, he will honor a god of fortresses in its place. A god his fathers did not know he will honor with gold, silver, precious stone, and desirable things.
verses.hebrew: וְלֶאֱלֹהַּ מָעֻזִּים עַל־כַּנּוֹ יְכַבֵּד וְלֶאֱלוֹהַּ אֲשֶׁר לֹא־יְדָעֻהוּ אֲבֹתָיו יְכַבֵּד בְּזָהָב וּבְכֶסֶף וּבְאֶבֶן יְקָרָה וּבַחֲמֻדוֹת׃

verses.english: He will act against strong fortresses with a foreign god. Those he acknowledges he will honor greatly, make them rule over many, and divide land for a price.
verses.hebrew: וְעָשָׂה לְמִבְצְרֵי מָעֻזִּים עִם־אֱלוֹהַּ נֵכָר אֲשֶׁר הכיר [יַכִּיר] יַרְבֶּה כָבוֹד וְהִמְשִׁילָם בָּרַבִּים וַאֲדָמָה יְחַלֵּק בִּמְחִיר׃

verses.english: At the time of the end, the king of the south will clash with him. The king of the north will storm against him with chariots, horsemen, and many ships. He will enter countries, flood through, and pass over.
verses.hebrew: וּבְעֵת קֵץ יִתְנַגַּח עִמּוֹ מֶלֶךְ הַנֶּגֶב וְיִשְׂתָּעֵר עָלָיו מֶלֶךְ הַצָּפוֹן בְּרֶכֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁים וּבָאֳנִיּוֹת רַבּוֹת וּבָא בַאֲרָצוֹת וְשָׁטַף וְעָבָר׃

verses.english: He will enter the Beautiful Land, and many will stumble. But these will escape his hand: Edom, Moab, and the chief part of the sons of Ammon.
verses.hebrew: וּבָא בְּאֶרֶץ הַצְּבִי וְרַבּוֹת יִכָּשֵׁלוּ וְאֵלֶּה יִמָּלְטוּ מִיָּדוֹ אֱדוֹם וּמוֹאָב וְרֵאשִׁית בְּנֵי עַמּוֹן׃

verses.english: He will stretch out his hand against countries, and Egypt’s land will not escape.
verses.hebrew: וְיִשְׁלַח יָדוֹ בַּאֲרָצוֹת וְאֶרֶץ מִצְרַיִם לֹא תִהְיֶה לִפְלֵיטָה׃

verses.english: He will rule over the hidden stores of gold and silver and all Egypt’s desirable things; Libyans and Cushites will follow in his steps.
verses.hebrew: וּמָשַׁל בְּמִכְמַנֵּי הַזָּהָב וְהַכֶּסֶף וּבְכֹל חֲמֻדוֹת מִצְרָיִם וְלֻבִים וְכֻשִׁים בְּמִצְעָדָיו׃

verses.english: Reports from the east and north will alarm him, and he will go out in great fury to destroy and devote many to destruction.
verses.hebrew: וּשְׁמֻעוֹת יְבַהֲלֻהוּ מִמִּזְרָח וּמִצָּפוֹן וְיָצָא בְּחֵמָא גְדֹלָה לְהַשְׁמִיד וּלְהַחֲרִים רַבִּים׃

verses.english: He will pitch his palatial tents between the seas and the beautiful holy mountain. He will come to his end, and no one will help him.”
verses.hebrew: וְיִטַּע אָהֳלֶי אַפַּדְנוֹ בֵּין יַמִּים לְהַר־צְבִי־קֹדֶשׁ וּבָא עַד־קִצּוֹ וְאֵין עוֹזֵר לוֹ׃

verses.english: At that time Michael will arise, the great prince who stands over the sons of your people. There will be a time of distress such as has not occurred since a nation came into being until that time. At that time your people will escape, everyone found written in the book.
verses.hebrew: וּבָעֵת הַהִיא יַעֲמֹד מִיכָאֵל הַשַּׂר הַגָּדוֹל הָעֹמֵד עַל־בְּנֵי עַמֶּךָ וְהָיְתָה עֵת צָרָה אֲשֶׁר לֹא־נִהְיְתָה מִהְיוֹת גּוֹי עַד הָעֵת הַהִיא וּבָעֵת הַהִיא יִמָּלֵט עַמְּךָ כָּל־הַנִּמְצָא כָּתוּב בַּסֵּפֶר׃

verses.english: Many of those sleeping in the dusty ground will awake: some to everlasting life, and some to reproaches and everlasting contempt.
verses.hebrew: וְרַבִּים מִיְּשֵׁנֵי אַדְמַת־עָפָר יָקִיצוּ אֵלֶּה לְחַיֵּי עוֹלָם וְאֵלֶּה לַחֲרָפוֹת לְדִרְאוֹן עוֹלָם׃

verses.english: The insightful will shine like the brightness of the firmament, and those who bring many to righteousness like the stars forever and ever.
verses.hebrew: וְהַמַּשְׂכִּלִים יַזְהִרוּ כְּזֹהַר הָרָקִיעַ וּמַצְדִּיקֵי הָרַבִּים כַּכּוֹכָבִים לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד׃

verses.english: But you, Daniel, close up the words and seal the book until the time of the end. Many will range to and fro, and knowledge will increase.”
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה דָנִיֵּאל סְתֹם הַדְּבָרִים וַחֲתֹם הַסֵּפֶר עַד־עֵת קֵץ יְשֹׁטְטוּ רַבִּים וְתִרְבֶּה הַדָּעַת׃

verses.english: I, Daniel, looked, and there were two others standing, one on this bank of the river and one on the other bank.
verses.hebrew: וְרָאִיתִי אֲנִי דָנִיֵּאל וְהִנֵּה שְׁנַיִם אֲחֵרִים עֹמְדִים אֶחָד הֵנָּה לִשְׂפַת הַיְאֹר וְאֶחָד הֵנָּה לִשְׂפַת הַיְאֹר׃

verses.english: One said to the man clothed in linen above the river’s waters, “How long until the end of these wonders?”
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לָאִישׁ לְבוּשׁ הַבַּדִּים אֲשֶׁר מִמַּעַל לְמֵימֵי הַיְאֹר עַד־מָתַי קֵץ הַפְּלָאוֹת׃

verses.english: I heard the man clothed in linen above the river’s waters raise his right hand and his left to heaven and swear by Him who lives forever: “It will be for a time, times, and half a time. When the shattering of the holy people’s power is completed, all these things will be finished.”
verses.hebrew: וָאֶשְׁמַע אֶת־הָאִישׁ לְבוּשׁ הַבַּדִּים אֲשֶׁר מִמַּעַל לְמֵימֵי הַיְאֹר וַיָּרֶם יְמִינוֹ וּשְׂמֹאלוֹ אֶל־הַשָּׁמַיִם וַיִּשָּׁבַע בְּחֵי הָעוֹלָם כִּי לְמוֹעֵד מוֹעֲדִים וָחֵצִי וּכְכַלּוֹת נַפֵּץ יַד־עַם־קֹדֶשׁ תִּכְלֶינָה כָל־אֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: I heard but did not understand. I said, “My lord, what will be the outcome of these things?”
verses.hebrew: וַאֲנִי שָׁמַעְתִּי וְלֹא אָבִין וָאֹמְרָה אֲדֹנִי מָה אַחֲרִית אֵלֶּה׃

verses.english: He said, “Go, Daniel, for the words are closed and sealed until the time of the end.
verses.hebrew: וַיֹּאמֶר לֵךְ דָּנִיֵּאל כִּי־סְתֻמִים וַחֲתֻמִים הַדְּבָרִים עַד־עֵת קֵץ׃

verses.english: Many will be purified, made white, and refined, but the wicked will act wickedly. None of the wicked will understand, but the insightful will understand.
verses.hebrew: יִתְבָּרֲרוּ וְיִתְלַבְּנוּ וְיִצָּרְפוּ רַבִּים וְהִרְשִׁיעוּ רְשָׁעִים וְלֹא יָבִינוּ כָּל־רְשָׁעִים וְהַמַּשְׂכִּלִים יָבִינוּ׃

verses.english: From the time the regular offering is removed and the desolating abomination is set up, there will be one thousand two hundred ninety days.
verses.hebrew: וּמֵעֵת הוּסַר הַתָּמִיד וְלָתֵת שִׁקּוּץ שֹׁמֵם יָמִים אֶלֶף מָאתַיִם וְתִשְׁעִים׃

verses.english: Blessed is the one who waits and reaches one thousand three hundred thirty-five days.
verses.hebrew: אַשְׁרֵי הַמְחַכֶּה וְיַגִּיעַ לְיָמִים אֶלֶף שְׁלֹשׁ מֵאוֹת שְׁלֹשִׁים וַחֲמִשָּׁה׃

verses.english: But you, go to the end. You will rest and stand for your allotted portion at the end of the days.”
verses.hebrew: וְאַתָּה לֵךְ לַקֵּץ וְתָנוּחַ וְתַעֲמֹד לְגֹרָלְךָ לְקֵץ הַיָּמִין׃
